Hi Ben,

Thanks for sending the intake form for Priya N. I pulled the supporting materials and there are two gaps before we can route to the calibration committee: 1) a concrete list of customer-impacting PR/feature ownership examples with dates, and 2) permission to include two customer-facing quotes (one will need redaction).

Ben — thanks for taking this on. Redaction standard is fine; two small asks: 1) For customer quotes, please include a one-line context for each quote (which product/feature and the quarter), and 2) mark any examples that relied on cross-team contributions — committee likes to see owner vs. collaborator calls.

If you anticipate sensitive naming (executive-level customers), mark that and we'll route the write-up to a limited-review panel first. Also: can you confirm if you want the committee booking to be a full panel or a single-level reviewer? I prefer full panel for this level.

Quick approval on the redaction approach. Send the PR list + context and we'll push for Sept 16 if the calendar allows.

—Laura
